dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Stanley... Stanley... Your name shall never be forgotten...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you repeating your own name?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Oh, you heard that? Ah, it's nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I'm simply lamenting the past, lamenting a friend that has passed...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: That's exactly what I'm doing. Why would I lie about it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Please, leave me. I need to be alone.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: *sigh* What I would give to have another mug with you, Stanley...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you feeling alright?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Ah, I... I'm fine, don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I just get sentimental sometimes on nights like this, as I listen to the din in the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: It brings me back to the days when I and Stanley had just started adventuring together. We'd always drink ourselves under the table the night before setting out.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's alright. I'll get up. For his sake, I definitely will.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: No problem. I just need to be alone for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: If only that fellow Stanley were here now...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I mean, Stanley's, uh, companion.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Indeed! If that fellow were also here, we would be enough to take Stormterror on, just the two of us!

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I really miss him. If only he were still with us...
